name: UpGuard
one_sentence: A deep charcoal canvas, green-as-status accent, Inter body with Plus Jakarta Sans display, glass cards with green-glow hover.

source.fidelity: token values consistent across DESIGN.md, brand.json and colors_and_type.css

light.reason: The system is authored as `color-scheme: dark` with `--bg #111821`. Any future light mode must be built as a separate, explicit token layer and is not part of this system.

surface.role: translucent glass card surfaces with blur(10px)

surface-elevated.role: modal / drawer / toast backing — more opaque for contrast

accent.role: CTAs, links, status-up, logo dot, green glows — the single brand accent

accent-dim.role: soft accent fill: icon circles, round-button hovers, chip backgrounds

400.role: gradient stop / primary button lighter end

mono.role: metrics, IDs, timestamps — fallback chain; not shipped as a woff2

posture: Direct and benefit-first — every message answers 'what does this do for me?'
Confident but plain — no hype, no exclamation overload
Operational and calm — the product is reliable, the voice reflects that
Technical enough for DevOps/SRE audiences, but never gate-kept by jargon
patterns: Short imperative CTAs: 'Start monitoring for free', 'Get started free'
Feature sentences lead with the verb: 'Get alerted if…', 'Know if…', 'Monitor any…'
Concrete numbers only: '30 seconds', '50 monitors', '99.98%' — never round up invented stats
Sentence case for headings and nav; CTAs are title-ish but informal
Use domain vocabulary: uptime, monitors, endpoint, response time, SSL, alerts, integrations
do_not: Do not use marketing fluff or urgency-scarcity language
Do not invent metrics; use honestly-labelled placeholders when a real value is missing
Do not use emoji or icon-as-copy replacements

danger.usage: destructive actions only — delete, remove, stop

icon_only.usage: table row actions, toolbars, topbar utilities

card.base: 1px solid #2d3540; background #131b25cc; backdrop-filter blur(10px); border-radius 12px; padding 28px
card.hover: border-color → #3bd671; transform translateY(-2px); box-shadow 0 8px 25px #3bd67126; icon glow intensifies
card.anti_pattern: No left color-stripe accent — the border itself turns green

nav.bar: sticky; gradient #111821cc → #131b25cc; backdrop-filter blur(2.5px); inset white highlight; 72px height

table.base: glass surface; sticky headers; sortable columns with arrow; row hover on --row-hover; right-aligned mono numbers; status badges
table.bulk: selection bar with green-tinted background; bulk actions left, pagination right
table.empty: honest placeholder with 'Keine Daten' / 'No data' state

form.field: label above; input #111821 with 1px #2d3540 border; focus ring #3bd671 with 3px halo
form.valid: subtle green border; never replace error state with success color alone

stats.kpi: large number (display or mono); label; delta badge ↑/↓ in green/red; mini sparkline with fill
stats.chart: one green main series; neutral comparison series; fill areas; no outline-only charts; no rainbow
stats.status_badge: pill with colored dot + label: ● Operational / Degraded / Down / Paused / Info

workflow: Paste or @import colors_and_type.css as the first style layer
Load self-hosted fonts from fonts/ (Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans, SIL OFL licensed)
Copy component markup from the matching ui_kits/* kit; bind classes to tokens
Keep it dark, keep it green, keep it glass; no raw hex outside tokens
For dashboards use the derived status/chart tokens; never introduce a second chromatic accent

anti_patterns: Never introduce a second chromatic accent — green is the only accent
Never use emoji as feature icons — inline SVG only
Never apply a left color-stripe on cards — full border turns green on hover
Never hot-link remote images — copy assets locally
Never use Inter as the display face — Plus Jakarta Sans only for headings
Never ship a light/cream default canvas — this is a dark theme
Never fabricate metrics — honest placeholders only
Never use outline-only charts — encode with fills
